
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(colf)
library(ggthemes)
library(Metrics)
source(here("helper/run_k_fold.R"))

bd <- read_csv(here("adults/adult_exposure_duration.csv"))
aligned_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_aligned_eig.csv"))
```



```{r}
full_k_fold_res <- lapply(
  unique(aligned_eig$param_id), 
  function(id){
    run_k_fold(p_id = id, 
               raw_d = bd, 
               sd = aligned_eig %>% filter(trial_number != 11))
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()
```



```{r}

full_k_fold_res %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_rsquared)) + 
  geom_histogram() 

aligned_eig %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = trial_number, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2))+ 
  theme_few() 


bd %>% 
  #filter(trial_number != 11) %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = fam_duration, y = total_rt, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2))+ 
  theme_few() 


aligned_eig %>% 
  filter(param_id == 93) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = fam_duration, y = mean_sample, color = trial_type)) + 
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", position = position_dodge(width = .2)) + 
  theme_few()
```
